'''Deron''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] employed by [[Vrath Xizor]] in [[3653 BBY]] for the purpose of tracking the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]]. The same year he participated in a [[Skirmish in the Yinta Lake spaceport|skirmish]] on [[Vulta]] with the rest of Xizor's team to try and capture Korr, yet Korr killed multiple members of the team and escaped with the assistance of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aryn Leneer]]. Deron and the other survivors were picked up in the group's speeder afterward. Deron asked Xizor why a Jedi would be involved with a spice-running smuggler such as Korr, but Xizor was unable to answer and ordered the men to regroup at [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].
